report: AgentHost Phase D/E - Agent Zero Capability Report & Compatibility Matrix
legend: SUPPORTED = verified in this eval; PARTIAL = exists but constrained (see notes); UNSUPPORTED = absent; UNKNOWN = not verifiable in this eval

Health.agent_zero: HTTP 200 on / ; no dedicated /health endpoint observed
Health.evidence: GET / returned 200; container logs show readiness line
Health.note: health() should check HTTP + optional /a0/usr writability

Streaming.agent_zero: WebSocket socket.io v4 (SID upgrade handshake verified; Web UI streams over WS); REST api_message returns final JSON only
Streaming.evidence: socket.io polling handshake HTTP 200, upgrades available, maxPayload 52428800

Models.agent_zero: Provider dropdowns + presets.yaml model_preset mechanism; providers: openrouter/anthropic/openai/gemini/ollama/groq/lm_studio/llama_cpp/omlx/vllm/a0_venice
Models.evidence: switched presets; verified runtime picks preset config

Tools.agent_zero: Auto-injected tool list per turn (response/code_exe/file/copy/bash/browser...); transparent journal
Tools.evidence: code_exe executed arithmetic; file tool created file; journal entries 0-21 expose types

Skills.agent_zero: Skills loaded on demand / pinned per chat; skill files under /a0/usr/skills
Skills.evidence: skills dir present in /a0/usr; documented protocol

Memory.agent_zero: faiss-based recall; util-LLM extracts memories each turn; project-scoped memory subdirs; observed 'No memories or solutions found' util entries every turn
Memory.evidence: recall executes per turn (journal); store+restart persistence not LLM-verifiable with available models (see model limit finding)
Memory.note: Memory quality tied to utility LLM strength

Browser.agent_zero: Built-in DOM-annotation browser + desktop; host browser via A0 CLI Connector
Browser.evidence: documented in official docs; included in image (browser canvas); not driven in this eval

Shell.agent_zero: code_execution/bash tools inside container; RFC for native Windows hosts

Filesystem.evidence: test-note.txt created by agent, retrieved via api_files_get

MCP.agent_zero: MCP client (mcp_servers config) + MCP server (SSE /mcp/sse, streamable HTTP /mcp/http/ with t-{TOKEN} URLs)
MCP.evidence: official connectivity docs + settings source; endpoint routing in helpers.api

Configuration.agent_zero: usr/settings.json + usr/.env (secrets) + plugin configs (presets.yaml/config.json) + legacy A0_SET_* env defaults
Configuration.evidence: settings.py source; env->defaults; file precedence (settings.json > env)

Logs.agent_zero: GET/POST /api/api_log_get per context (journal items) + docker logs

Metrics.agent_zero: No metrics endpoint observed; uvicorn access logs toggle exists
Metrics.evidence: not found in API surface; docker stats available externally

Cancel.agent_zero: api_terminate_chat (destructive) exists; in-flight cancel via WebSocket UI events (ws handlers)
Cancel.evidence: terminate verified; in-flight cancel not independently verified

functional_test_summary.basic_interaction: PASS - question answered via REST API (local qwen2.5-coder:14b)
functional_test_summary.reasoning_multi_step: PARTIAL - arithmetic computed via code_exe tool execution (journal-verified); verbose multi-step prompts fail local 14B model JSON protocol (5-strike unusable guard)
functional_test_summary.files: PASS - agent created /a0/usr/workdir/test-note.txt ('agent zero smoke test'); read back via api_files_get (base64)
functional_test_summary.shell: PARTIAL - code_exe (Python) tool execution verified via journal; interactive bash tool turn not verifiable with free-tier models
functional_test_summary.web: UNVERIFIED - browser surface present in image/UI; not driven (requires GUI + stronger model)
functional_test_summary.memory: PARTIAL - per-turn recall engaged (journal util entries); store/restart persistence not LLM-verified
functional_test_summary.tools_discovery: PASS - tool list injected per turn into model prompt; journal exposes executed tool types
functional_test_summary.streaming: PARTIAL - socket.io/WebSocket handshake verified; REST is request/response
functional_test_summary.failure_unusable_model_output: PASS - 5-consecutive-unusable guard returns error JSON after model fails protocol (observed repeatedly with local 14B)
functional_test_summary.failure_rate_limits: PASS - provider rate-limit errors surfaced as structured API errors
functional_test_summary.terminate_chat: PASS - {"success": true}; subsequent use of context fails with 'Context not found'

model_provider_findings.local_ollama_7b_14b: qwen2.5-coder:7b and :14b (Ollama, host GPU) work for simple single-turn chat and single code_exe calls, but fail v2.8 unified_turn JSON protocol on multi-tool/complex prompts (5x unusable response guard triggers). Local-14B is NOT a viable full agent model on this machine.
model_provider_findings.groq_free_tier: Protocol-compliant for tool flows (file creation succeeded with llama-3.3-70b-versatile), but free tier TPM caps (8k/12k/6k per model) are BELOW Agent Zero's minimum per-request size (~11.3k tokens: agent prompt + tool definitions), making sustained use impractical; each turn needs a fresh minute window.
model_provider_findings.openrouter: Key present on host but account has no credits (HTTP 402 'never purchased credits'); unusable without top-up.
model_provider_findings.cloud_requirement: Agent Zero v2.8 is designed for strong paid/cloud models (presets shipped default to gpt-5.6-class and gemini-flash-lite); project docs warn small local models fail utility/memory tasks.
